source_title: Hunter x Hunter Creator Togashi Announces New Sequel Update
source_excerpt:
Hunter x Hunter is one of the most iconic shonen series of the last 20 years. The story by Yoshihiro Togashi has grown tremendously in terms of popularity, and that is despite the many breaks the franchise has been plagued with over the last two decades. Hunter x Hunter has now come to be known for its long hiatuses, but things have been gradually improving for the series over the last couple of years.
While Togashi went back on hiatus after 10 exciting chapters in September 2026, he is already nearing his return once again. Yoshihiro Togashi has now officially announced in a new X post from October 26, 2026, that the manuscript for chapter 430 of Hunter x Hunter is officially completed. Hunter x Hunter's new sequel batch covering chapters 421 to 430 is just ahead of us, with the series potentially making its comeback in 2027, if not sooner.
Hunter x Hunter Author Togashi Announces The Completion of Chapter 430’s Manuscript
Hunter x Hunter is the second hit series by legendary mangaka Yoshihiro Togashi. Despite being far from complete, this manga is his biggest ever and has even surpassed its legendary predecessor, Yu Yu Hakusho. Hunter x Hunter saw the beginning of its serialization in 1998 in the popular shonen magazine Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump. Since then, this manga has definitely stood out among its peers and carved an amazing legacy for itself thanks to its intricate plot, captivating power system, and amazing characters.
The series has been growing in popularity despite the big hurdles it has faced since 2006. 20 years ago, Hunter x Hunter started to go on breaks frequently. These breaks were taken by the creator, Yoshihiro Togashi, who was dealing with various health issues, especially those pertaining to his back. These issues were mostly caused by the intense work that comes with being a mangaka. For 2 decades, Hunter x Hunter's publication was halted, with only a couple of chapters released every few years. In fact, the breaks got so hectic that the first 8 years of Hunter x Hunter have seen far more story progress compared to the last 20.
Luckily, Hunter x Hunter's future looks bright as the series is now set to officially make yet another comeback, giving them more content to drive forward the ongoing Succession Contest Arc. Since 2024, Togashi has been working harder than ever before to deliver new, exciting chapters and finally mark the end of the new arc. In 2024, Togashi released chapters 401 to 410 between October 7, 2024, and December 9, 2024. While we didn't have high expectations afterwards for a swift return, Togashi surprised us and returned on June 28, 2026 , with 10 new chapters, which finally concluded in September 2026.
Hunter x Hunter has only just left us a month ago. Despite that, it's looking for a quick return already. On October 26, 2026, Yoshihiro Togashi (@Un4v5s8bgsVk9Xp) announced a big update on his X social media. Togashi revealed that his manuscript for chapter 430 is officially complete. In other words, the chapter will soon be sent to Shueisha as new ready-to-publish content.
HxH Chapter 430’s Completion Marks The Return Of The Series With A Sequel Chapter Batch
The completion of Hunter x Hunter chapter 430 is major news for fans of the series. To understand why, we simply have to look at the previous two returns of Hunter x Hunter . Since 2024, Togashi has been consistently returning every time with a batch of exactly 10 chapters. It's unclear why, but it seems like a new work schedule for consistent Weekly Shonen Jump serialization of his manga.
In 2024, he returned with chapters 401 to 410, and in 2026, he delivered 411 to 420. Now, he has wrapped up chapter 430, and we can also confirm from previous updates that Togashi has also completed chapters spanning from 421 to 429 . In other words, Togashi has officially finished his sequel batch of chapters. With 10 chapters done, it means the serialization can resume soon.
Hunter x Hunter’s Sequel Batch Release Date
We’re all excited for the possibility of an early Hunter x Hunter return. After years of slow publication, to have some sort of consistent release is definitely a dream come true for any Hunter x Hunter fan. We're especially hoping that the next couple of batches will finally deliver the conclusion of the current ongoing Succession Contest Arc. This manga arc has been a highlight of the series, but with it having started back in 2014, we’re eager to see it end and for the Black Whale to reach the Dark Continent where our main characters explore the mysterious land.
For now, we’re waiting for the next batch that Togashi has finished to see when it could potentially resume its serialization. Previously, when Togashi completed the batch spanning from chapters 411 to 420, the magazine still delayed the publication by a few months. While we previously believed Hunter x Hunter's return would be sometime in early 2027, it is possible to see the series return as early as December 2026, based on the new Togashi update. Hunter x Hunter's return would be a massive boost to the magazine that is currently struggling with decreasing sales .

What To Expect From The Next Hunter x Hunter Chapters
With so many plot points overlapping and existing independently in the Succession Contest arc, it is hard to guess what Togashi has planned to tackle next. However, with Gon and Killua's short teaser in Hunter x Hunter chapter 414 , we are hoping for at least one chapter panning the attention back to these two characters. They are a beloved duo that we haven't seen in action for over a decade, with the conclusion of the 13th Chairman election arc. As teased by the latest chapter, they are set to become the new protectors of Prince Wobble, who never boarded the Black Whale in the first place.
We do wonder, however, what the fate of Hunter x Hunter entails after the release of these 10 new chapters. If Hunter x Hunter returns sometime in December 2026, then we will have enough content for 2.5 months based on a weekly release schedule with no breaks. In these months, it's simply impossible for Togashi to finish his next batch of chapters or to make any significant progress on them. In other words, the batch that follows after Chapter 430 will take a lot longer to wrap up, as Togashi has already worked hard over the last year. At the very least, we expect a break of at least 1 year.
We do know, however, that Togashi has plans to work on more chapters and that he isn't ready to throw in the towel yet. The author has confirmed previously that he intends to complete a total of 50 new chapters, which would put us at the current progression of the story at Chapter 450 of the manga if he keeps his promise. As long as his health is maintained, we’re going to see consistent progress in the story. A proper conclusion of Hunter x Hunter is not something Togashi has ever promised, but we're happy with any small steps the author takes.
